newsitem.title: USA: Heartland chairman Holland steps down.
newsitem.headline: Heartland chairman Holland steps down.

text.p: Heartland Wireless Communications Inc said on Tuesday that J.R. Holland Jr stepped down as chairman, but will remain as a member of the board of directors.

Hartland also said that David Webb, president and chief executive of CS Wireless Systems Inc, resigned from Heartland's board to devote more time to CS Wireless. Webb resigned as president and chief executive of Heartland in January to assume the same titles at CS Wireless.
Heartland co-owns CS Wireless with CAI Wireless Systems Inc.
Heartland on March 20 reported a fourth-quarter loss of $9.6 million before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.

Heartland's interim president and chief executive, John Fanning, said in a statement that the chairman position will be left vacant for the time being while the board members "undertake various projects to expedite the company's restructuring efforts."
Heartland shares closed Tuesday at 2-3/8, up 1/4 on the day.
